Power Supply

The unit operates on a standard power supply of 220-240V, 1Ph, 50Hz for both indoor and outdoor units, ensuring compatibility with various electrical systems.

Cooling and Heating Capacity

With a cooling capacity of 18000 BTU/h and a heating capacity of 19000 BTU/h, this air conditioner offers powerful and efficient cooling and heating performance to keep your space comfortable year-round.

Outdoor Temperature Range

Withstands outdoor temperatures ranging from -15～50°C for cooling and -15～24°C for heating, ensuring reliable operation in extreme conditions.

Input Power and Rated Current

The input power for cooling is 1700W, with a rated current of 7.5A, while for heating, the input power is 1423W, with a rated current of 6.3A, ensuring energy-efficient operation.

Quiet Operation

Equipped with low-noise indoor and outdoor fan motors, the unit operates quietly while maintaining a comfortable environment.

Indoor Fan Motor

Equipped with a high-performance ZKFP-46-8-1 fan motor, providing efficient air circulation with variable speeds of 752/664/576 r/min (High/Medium/Low).

Indoor Coil

The indoor coil features 2 rows of hydrophilic aluminum fins and a Φ7 Inner groove tube design, ensuring efficient heat transfer and durability.

Indoor Unit Dimensions

The indoor unit has compact dimensions of 570x570x260 mm (Width x Depth x Height), making it suitable for various installation spaces.

Outdoor Unit Dimensions

The outdoor unit measures 800x333x554 mm (Width x Depth x Height), designed for durability and resistance to outdoor elements.

Refrigerant Type

Utilizes environmentally friendly refrigerant R410A/1.35/R32, ensuring efficient cooling/heating performance while minimizing environmental impact.

Thermostat Type

Features a convenient remote control thermostat, allowing users to adjust temperature settings and other functions for personalized comfort.

Operation Temperature

Operates within a temperature range of 17~30°C, ensuring reliable performance even in varying environmental conditions.

Room Temperature Range

Maintains indoor temperatures between 17～32°C for cooling and 0～30°C for heating, ensuring comfort in various weather conditions.
